  AGENDA
  Study Session Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 8, 2026 - 4:30 p.m.

  Phone one-tap to Join:

  .
  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Beginning July 1, 2026, all City Council Meetings are conducted in a hybrid model per Senate Bill
  707 (2025). Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers, watch and
  participate in the meeting through Zoom, or watch the meeting through a Live Stream (City
  Website), Cable TV Channel 10 or watch a recording after the fact of the meeting (City Video
  Archives). City Council Chamber doors open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  Zoom participants are automatically muted and may view, listen, and provide audio public
  comment when permitted (see “Public Comment/Public Participation”). Meetings are recorded,
  and all rules of decorum apply to both in-person and remote participants.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting, may
  submit written comments via email before or at the meeting or attend virtually and provide
  comments. Public comments must address an agenda item or an item within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the City Council.

  When attending in-person, submit a Public Speaker card or Written Comment card to the City
  Clerk prior to the start of the Public Comments period for non-agenda items or prior to the agenda
  item being called.

  3272210.2
 When attending through Zoom, follow the instructions to indicate you wish to speak during the
meeting. You will be asked to raise your hands via Zoom (audio only; cameras will not be
activated for the public). When recognized by the City Clerk, unmute your microphone (Zoom
Host will grant permission) and provide comments. At the conclusion of your time, your ability to
unmute will be removed by the Zoom host. Individuals joining by telephone, press *9 to raise your
hand and when called upon by the City Clerk, press *6 to unmute and provide comments. Remote
participants must be present when called and are responsible for ensuring that they are connected
and able to hear the meeting.

Public speakers are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for
meeting management purposes. A speaker’s time may not be transferred to another speaker.
Remote public speakers will receive the same time allotment as a member of the public
commenting in person.

Please be mindful that the meeting will be recorded and all rules of decorum apply for in-person
and virtual attendees.

WRITTEN COMMENT
Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets. Written
comments will not be read aloud by the City. A summary including the number of emails and
contents may be provided by the City Clerk.

Remote Access Disruption
In accordance with the Brown Act and City Council Resolution No. 2459-26, if the internet or
telephone service for the Zoom Host (City) goes down during the meeting, a recess will be called
for the meeting to allow staff to investigate the issue.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using
 “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the
 meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours and are posted on the
 City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Watch the City Council Meeting Video LIVE or to rewatch a prior meeting video, click “City Council
 Agendas, Minutes & Video” (http://westlakevillage.granicus.com/viewpublisher.php?view_id=8) City
 Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org

3272210.2
 CALL TO ORDER: 4:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. See pages 1 and 2 for instructions on speaking in-person and virtually.

STUDY SESSION:

1.  PURE WATER PROJECT STUDY SESSION - City Council to receive information
  regarding the Pure Water Project.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 2, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  July 2, 2026
